results.scenario: As the seeded owner Ada North (subject auth0|6728f0a1b2c3d4e5f6789012), this flow authenticates via Auth0 password grant with a customFetch that rewrites HTTPS URLs to HTTP (because the local issuer runs HTTP-only on port 3000), records an expense with a unique per-run merchant name and amount using the create_expense MCP tool, then verifies that exact expense appears in the organization's expense list returned by list_expenses. The flow asserts the created expense's id is a UUID, all fields match the submitted values (merchant, amountMinor, currency GBP, category travel, status submitted), the memberId matches Ada's member record, and occurredAt is a valid ISO-8601 timestamp. Cleanup deletes the expense row directly via Postgres and verifies exactly one row was affected.
